hover.reply: Hover was drawn as a still end pose, so there was nothing to see. It is now a real transition: the pointed part animates in and back out, the out exactly the in reversed in the same time. Three options: the sun climbs its arc (recommended), the low sun rakes along the foot, the sun's path is drawn.

press.comment: I feel like we can do better
press.reply: The old press was a barely visible colour change. It now moves with the sun, in and back out with equal time, and its words are clearly readable. Three options: the sun swells (recommended), the day breaks, light closes in from the rim.
